name: one-way-a-b
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). At 12 s frames from A to B stop arriving while B stays alive (B to A still works). The A-B link is one-way, so it is not usable, and the controller reroutes via D.
